assertions.name: mentions_dPdt
assertions.check: output contains 'dP/dt' or 'physical velocity' or 'prototype iteration'

assertions.name: cites_specific_project
assertions.check: output mentions at least 1 specific project by name

assertions.name: gives_ratio
assertions.check: output contains a numerical ratio (X:1 or X:Y or percentage)

assertions.name: recommends_action
assertions.check: output contains at least 1 actionable recommendation

assertions.name: checks_physical_gate
assertions.check: output mentions physical gate deadline or timeline

assertions.name: warns_if_zero
assertions.check: if dP/dt = 0, output contains explicit warning

assertions.name: under_500_words
assertions.check: output is concise (under 500 words for actionability)
